resources.string: NetGuard helps you access websites and apps through a VPN and choose a suitable connection method.\n\nIt supports subscriptions, individual servers and connections through video meetings. You can change the main settings at any time.

The app compares access to a website directly and through the VPN. Once a check provides enough evidence, it remembers a suitable route and checks it again periodically.\n\nThe first visit may use the VPN while checks run. You can select apps that must always use the VPN.

WB Stream carries Internet traffic inside a video meeting stream. It provides another connection method when an ordinary VPN is unavailable but WB Stream still works.\n\nYou need a configured server and a WB Stream room. Automatic recovery helps maintain the connection, but speed and reliability depend on the network and the service. An ordinary VPN may be faster for large downloads.

The current server appears on Home. Diagnostics show check results and the routes actually used.\n\nIf a connection stalls or slows down, save a log immediately after the problem to help identify the cause. A successful check of one website does not guarantee that every app feature works.
